action.old_str:
{Array.from({ length: 17 }).map((_, i) => (
      <group key={`cell_tap_${i}`}>
        {/* 100mA Fast-acting Protection Fuse at contact point */}
        <fuse name={`F${i}`} value="100mA" footprint="0603" />
        {/* RC Filter for cell sensing ADC input */}
        <resistor name={`R_VC${i}`} value="100" footprint="0603" />
        <capacitor name={`C_VC${i}`} value="0.1uF" footprint="0603" />
action.new_str:
{Array.from({ length: 17 }).map((_, i) => (
      <group key={`cell_tap_${i}`}>
        {/* 100mA Fast-acting Protection Fuse at contact point */}
        <fuse name={`F${i}`} currentRating="100mA" footprint="0603" />
        {/* RC Filter for cell sensing ADC input */}
        <resistor name={`R_VC${i}`} resistance="100" footprint="0603" />
        <capacitor name={`C_VC${i}`} capacitance="0.1uF" footprint="0603" />

tool_call.name: file_editor
